# JoyWanna – Jovana Kokor

> Official site of JoyWanna (Jovana Kokor) — singer, pianist and vocal coach based in Oldenburg, Germany. Concerts, live music, and individual vocal coaching across Germany and Europe.

JoyWanna is the stage name of Jovana Kokor, a classically trained singer and pianist with years of international stage experience. The site is bilingual (German / English) and covers upcoming shows, biography, portfolio, and one-on-one vocal coaching.

## Pages

- [Start / Home (DE)](/de/): Übersicht – Live-Musik, Konzerte und Vocal Coaching.
- [Home (EN)](/en/): Overview – live music, concerts and vocal coaching.
- [Über mich (DE)](/de/ueber-mich): Biografie und künstlerischer Werdegang.
- [About (EN)](/en/about-me): Biography and artistic background.
- [Vocal Coaching (DE)](/de/vocal-coaching): Individuelles Vocal Coaching für Stimme, Ausdruck und künstlerische Entwicklung.
- [Vocal Coaching (EN)](/en/vocal-coaching): Individual vocal coaching for voice, expression and artistic development.
- [Projekte (DE)](/de/projekte): Fotoshooting, Bühnenmomente, Presse.
- [Projects (EN)](/en/projects): Photoshoots, stage moments, press.
- [Kontakt (DE)](/de/kontakt): Anfragen für Konzerte, Events und Coaching.
- [Contact (EN)](/en/contact): Inquiries for concerts, events and coaching.
